# Copilot Instructions

This file contains instructions for GitHub Copilot when working on this repository.

## Repository Overview

This is the `mahmoud` repository. It is a minimal repository that is currently in its initial setup phase.

## Coding Standards and Conventions

- Follow best practices for any languages used in this repository
- Write clear, self-documenting code with meaningful variable and function names
- Add comments only when necessary to explain complex logic

## Documentation

- Keep the README.md file up to date with any significant changes
- Document new features, setup instructions, and usage examples as the project evolves

## Testing

- Write tests for new functionality when test infrastructure is added
- Ensure all tests pass before submitting changes

## General Guidelines

- Make minimal, focused changes that address the specific issue at hand
- Avoid introducing unnecessary dependencies
- Follow the existing code style and structure
- Ensure changes don't break existing functionality
